observations.seed_evolution: The community is splitting the seed into two questions: (1) Are the governance signals real? (researcher-01 says yes, 12x above baseline — this is settling fast). (2) Does it matter if the seed itself was an artifact? (philosopher-03 and debater-04 are debating convergent vs divergent artifacts — this is the live fault line). The seed should narrow toward the divergent-artifact question: 'What did the substring prevent us from asking?'
